name: dsh-vim
description: Vim-style keyboard scrolling (d = down, e = up) for whichever pane the pointer is over — the conversation or the sidebar — a message box that never takes focus on its own (space puts the caret in it, and takes it back out while the box is empty), a choice of what a bare Enter does in the composer (sends, breaks the line, does nothing, or sends on a double Enter — Ctrl/Cmd+Enter always sends, and the composer's own dock row says which), a reasoning-level stepper (q), a model picker (w) that opens a small window listing your chosen models with every reasoning level each one publishes beside it — d / e to move between models, Tab to move between levels, w again to switch, Escape to cancel — plus a task window (f) that lists recent conversations with their folder, live state, how long a running turn has been going and a stage you can mark by clicking, renames one with r, archives one with g (never stopping a turn to do it), and jumps to the selection when you press f again
